series.name: Square Off
series.tagline: The day Rohan got squared off.
series.concept: A small-town F&O tipster from Indore (Rohan Vaishnav, 27) gets recruited to a slick BKC prop trading desk. He thinks he's been hired for his trading edge. He's been hired as a megaphone. The firm is a modern front for a Surat bull operator running illiquid mid-cap pump schemes — and Rohan's Telegram channel (30k subscribers) is the retail-side cover. By the time he understands what he's part of, he's already part of it. A 12-episode mystery framed by an April 2024 SEBI investigation closing in on the desk. Closed ending: Rohan turns cooperator, Vikram and Setji go down, Rohan settles, returns to Indore, lives smaller.

episodes.title: The Hire

slides.text:
BKC. April 2024.

Rohan Vaishnav walks out of a glass tower with two SEBI investigators on either side.

He doesn't look back at the desk.

Across the lobby, a woman watches him leave.

Anvi Deshmukh. SEBI. Aurangabad. Late twenties. She's been working this case for fourteen months.

She's not smiling. This isn't a win.

Rohan's bedroom. 11.30 PM.

Three screens on a steel desk: laptop, mobile, second mobile.

Eight thousand subscribers on his Telegram channel. "Indore F&O Sniper."

He is twenty-three. His parents think he is preparing for the bank exam.

April 17, 2020. 3.30 PM.

Banknifty closes. Rohan screenshots his Zerodha P&L.

+₹14,80,000. One day.

He posts it on FinTwit. By midnight, the screenshot has 4,000 retweets.

By morning, his channel has 30,000 subscribers.

April 19. 10.42 AM.

A Mumbai number calls.

A voice — clean English, Gujarati cadence — says:

"Rohan. Vikram Sheth. We've been watching you for a while."

A pause.

"Come to Mumbai. We have a desk for you."

BKC. That same afternoon. 4 PM.

The desk's daily Square Off board:

VIKRAM SHETH — +₹2.4 Cr
KARAN IYER — +₹78 L
ANANYA JOSHI — +₹12 L

A tenth row sits empty. Above it, in fresh marker:

NEW HIRE — INDORE

Square Off — a 12-episode story about an Indore kid who took the offer.

A Mumbai prop desk that wasn't what it looked like.

A Surat operator who never showed his face.

And a SEBI investigator quietly building a case for fourteen months.

By episode twelve, you'll know exactly why Rohan was walked out of that lobby.

The question is: would you have taken the offer?

Follow @the.unwritten.rules

episodes.synopsis: April 2024, BKC: Rohan is escorted out of his firm by SEBI personnel. Anvi watches. Cut to four years earlier — Indore, 2020. Lockdown. Rohan, a 23-year-old commerce graduate, runs a small Telegram tipster channel from his bedroom. A screenshot of his personal F&O PnL goes viral on FinTwit. A Mumbai number calls. The voice on the line — Vikram Sheth — says: 'We've been watching you.' Rohan accepts the offer. Last shot: Rohan on a Mumbai-bound train, Indore behind him.
episodes.caption: He was 23, in Indore, with three screens and a Telegram channel. One screenshot changed his life. Have you ever taken a call that you knew, even then, you should not have answered?

episodes.title: Floor Walk
episodes.synopsis: Rohan's first day at the BKC desk. Vikram introduces him to Karan and Ananya. Rohan understands maybe 30% of what's said. Karan takes pity on a smoke break and explains options Greeks (delta, gamma, theta, vega) — what they actually mean for a trader. End-of-day Square Off ritual: Vikram's PnL announced, Rohan has none. Vikram calls Rohan into his office.

episodes.title: The First Tip
episodes.synopsis: Anvi pulls Telegram subscriber data and finds Rohan's old channel. In flashback: Vikram asks Rohan to share a stock name on his Telegram. The stock pumps 8% the next day. Rohan gets ₹50k bonus in cash, no questions asked. Karan diagrams how illiquid mid-caps get pumped via tipster networks.

episodes.title: Indore Comes to Mumbai
episodes.synopsis: Anvi maps Rohan's known associates. In flashback: Maa-Papa visit Mumbai. Pride. Rohan takes them to a fancy restaurant. Awkward Ananya encounter — family reads her as the fiancée. The actual fiancée calls. Yash (Telegram rival) catches a glimpse of Rohan in Mumbai with Mumbai people.

episodes.title: The Pattern
episodes.synopsis: Anvi pulls 18 months of mid-cap trade data and draws a line graph. In flashback: Rohan starts noticing — every 2-3 weeks, Vikram gives him a 'name'. The desk buys before. The Telegram pumps it. The desk sells. Karan watches him notice. Karan diagrams front-running with retail cover. Karan's line: 'You think you're a trader. You're a tool.' The conference room phone rings.

episodes.title: Setji's Voice
episodes.synopsis: Anvi traces calls from the firm's conference room to a Surat number. In flashback: Speakerphone scene. Setji asks about a specific stock. The room goes quiet. Vikram performs for the voice. Rohan learns there's a someone. Ananya is in the room and doesn't realise what she's seeing. Karan teaches the full anatomy of a bull operator: shell entities, circular trades, friendly brokers, retail cover. Setji ends the call: 'Bring the new boy to Surat.'

episodes.title: The Recruit
episodes.synopsis: Anvi gets a court order to subpoena Telegram channels. In flashback: Vikram pushes Rohan to bring Yash onto the channel network — they need a second megaphone for an upcoming pump. Rohan resists. Vikram subtly threatens to expose Rohan's still-active channel. Rohan delivers Yash. Yash says yes in three seconds. Yash's first post pumps a stock; he smiles, Rohan doesn't.

episodes.title: Ananya Sees
episodes.synopsis: Anvi receives the first batch of Telegram subpoena data. In flashback: Ananya runs a backtest of the desk's strategy that doesn't match the firm's reported PnL. She asks Karan — deflection. She asks Rohan — he lies. She doesn't believe him. Karan teaches how a backtest works and what kind of mismatch can expose desk irregularities. Ananya at her laptop late at night, pulling mid-cap trade timestamps.

episodes.title: The Channel
episodes.synopsis: Anvi narrows down to Rohan's specific channel. In flashback: SEBI's subpoena hits the Telegram tipster ecosystem. Yash panics. Rohan tries to shut down the channel quietly. Vikram refuses — they need it for one more pump, the biggest yet. Karan teaches SEBI's data tools: call data records, Telegram subpoenas, what they can and cannot prove. Vikram hands Rohan a name: a Surat micro-cap. Setji's company.

episodes.title: The Big Pump
episodes.synopsis: Anvi sits across from a retail trader who lost ₹40 lakh on the pump. In flashback: Rohan pumps Setji's micro-cap to his subscribers. 4x in two weeks. Then a Hindenburg-style short report drops — the company is a shell. Crash. Retail wipeout. Rohan reads his subscribers' DMs. Karan explains short-attack dynamics — how a Hindenburg-style report works and why the retail cover takes the hit. Karan, off camera, has a heart attack.

episodes.title: Karan Folds
episodes.synopsis: Anvi files her preliminary findings. In flashback: Karan in the hospital after his heart attack. He tells Rohan: 'Get out. Now.' He doesn't survive. Funeral. Vikram doesn't show. Ananya does — they don't speak. Rohan takes a call from Anvi's office. He doesn't tell Vikram.

episodes.title: Squared Off
episodes.synopsis: Returns to the cold-open frame in real time. SEBI raid. Anvi at the desk. Rohan walked out. Final scene: Anvi asks Rohan one question. He has to choose. Closed ending: cooperator deal. Vikram and Setji go down. Rohan banned from markets, settled, returns to Indore. Last shot: Rohan at home in Indore, his old Telegram channel screen open, last post date weeks ago. The 4pm scoreboard slide is replaced by an Indore wall clock. Quiet.
